LI QinWANG Rui1 Marine Drug and Food InstitutePcean University of ChinaQingdao266003；1Chinese PLA General HospitalBeijing 100853 ABSTRACT As one of major cytochrome P450s CYP2D6 is responsible for many important drugs’metabolism．The genetic polymorphism of CYP2D6is the ba-sis of siqnificant individual variability in the metabolism of drugs．Meanwhilemany drugs can influence the activity of CYP2D6by competitive inhibition or inductionwhich is easy to cause interaction in coadministration．So we will investigate the relations of genetic polymorphism of CYP2D6to drug interactions from such aspects as phenotypecompetitive inhibition of substratesinduction or inhibition of CYP2D6.
